title: How do we know how far away the Moon is?
note: LOOK TEST v2 (15 Nov 2026), not an episode. Facts: APOLLO lunar laser ranging at Apache Point Observatory, New Mexico; Apollo 11/14/15 retroreflectors; mean distance 384,400 km; round trip about 2.5 s.

lines.text: On a mountain in New Mexico, astronomers fire a laser at the Moon.
The pulse of light crosses three hundred and eighty-four thousand kilometres of empty space…
hits a mirror the Apollo astronauts left behind, and comes home two and a half seconds later.
